column1: # comment: "Cognition alignments \u2014 the knowledge spectrum. schema.org offers a single flat knowsAbout; GMEOW's four-level spectrum down-collapses to it (lossy), and a bare schema:knowsAbout lifts to the eponymous gmeow:knowsAbout level (its honest floor \u2014 depth is never inferred from a flat edge)."

column6: schema:knowsAbout — an agent's knowledge of a subject — is exactly the gmeow:knowsAbout level of the four-level knowledge spectrum; the finer levels (understands, hasMastered) are GMEOW enrichment that down-collapses to this flat target.
